name: Potassium stearate
description: Potassium stearate (CAS 593-29-3 ) is the potassium salt of stearic acid, produced by neutralizing stearic acid with potassium hydroxide. It functions as an emulsifier, lubricant, and stabilizer across personal care, industrial, and food-related manufacturing processes. In personal care, it acts as the primary soap-forming agent in solid and liquid formulations, providing lather structure and skin-conditioning properties that define product texture. Plastics processors use it as an internal and external lubricant and heat stabilizer, particularly in PVC compounding where it prevents degradation during high-temperature processing. Textile and leather finishing operations apply it as a softening and surface-conditioning agent to improve handle and water resistance in treated fabrics. In food-grade applications, it functions as an emulsifier and anti-caking agent in dry mixes, coatings, and processed food manufacturing. Potassium stearate is supplied as a white powder or flakes, with particle size and purity varying by application grade. Food-grade material is available to FCC specification. Cosmetic and pharmaceutical supply typically meets USP or BP standards.
